drhp.business: Established in 1973, the Company manufactures and exports gelatine (edible, pharmaceutical, photographic and technical grades), ossein and di-calcium phosphate (DCP) from its manufacturing facility at Vapi, Gujarat. Its products serve pharmaceutical (capsule manufacturing), food & confectionery, nutraceutical, cosmetics and industrial customers, with a strong export franchise across the USA, Europe, Japan, Korea, the Middle East and other regions.

drhp.expansion: The Company has undertaken a phased expansion and modernization project to upgrade and revamp its existing Gelatine plant, raising production capacity from 2,000 MT per annum to up to 2,700 MT per annum. Phase I of the project, comprising installation of a new dryer and ultrafiltration system, is expected to raise capacity to approximately 2,500 MT per annum from the second half of FY 2026-27, with additional revenue expected to follow commissioning and stabilisation. drhp.one_liner: India Gelatine & Chemicals Limited is a Vapi (Gujarat)-based manufacturer and exporter of gelatine, ossein and di-calcium phosphate (DCP), with approximately 90% of its gelatine production exported to pharmaceutical, food, nutraceutical and cosmetic customers worldwide.

plants.role: Manufacturing facility for gelatine, ossein and DCP

risks.note: Availability and pricing of crushed/imported bones, HCL and lime are critical to stable operations and product quality; the AR flags raw material volatility as a dynamic risk to the business.
The Company operates in a dynamic environment exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations, relevant given its heavy reliance on export revenue.
CPCB has advised that industrial consumables (e.g. HCL) must be FDA/FSSAI-approved; the Company is in discussions with authorities pending a resolution, an unresolved regulatory risk.
Ongoing geopolitical tensions, including the war in the Middle East, have impacted LSHS availability and logistics costs, increasing input cost pressures and posing risks to supply chains.
Approximately 90% of gelatine production is exported; overseas markets face stiff price competition and global oversupply from South America and Turkey has pressured realizations.
Competition from plant-based alternatives such as agar-agar, pectin and carrageenan may impact long-term demand for gelatine.

Gelatine and ossein sales declined 16% and 30% respectively in FY2025-26 primarily due to reduction in selling prices, showing revenue's sensitivity to global price realizations despite stable underlying demand.
